name: Goblin Foundry
summary: The Goblin Foundry is an industrial workshop deep within the Deadmines where goblin tinkerers labored to manufacture heavy machinery for Edwin VanCleef's rebellion. Centered around a massive smelting cauldron, the chamber fell into chaos when the experimental harvest golems housed within abruptly came to life.

sections.title: Industrial Ambitions
sections.body: Carved into the subterranean depths of Moonbrook, the Goblin Foundry provided the Defias Brotherhood with the heavy manufacturing power required to fuel their uprising. Utilizing vast smelters, iron ramps, and goblin engineering expertise, the workshop mass-produced mechanical armaments. Among their most ambitious endeavors was the construction of the Foe Reaper 5000, an upgraded iteration of Westfall's familiar automated reapers.

sections.title: A Malfunction in Iron
sections.body: Goblin ingenuity notoriously borders on catastrophe, and the foundry's crowning achievement proved to be its undoing. The prototype harvest golems turned against their creators, animating uncontrollably and driving out or slaughtering the foundry's workforce. The machinery now stomps unchecked across the iron catwalks, leaving the smelters abandoned to rogue automatons.

faq.q: What was being built in the Goblin Foundry?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood hired goblin engineers to smelt iron and build mechanical weaponry. Their primary project was constructing powerful mechanized harvest golems, specifically the lethal prototype known as the Foe Reaper 5000.

faq.q: Why are there harvest golems in the foundry?
faq.answer: The harvest golems were being manufactured and upgraded on-site by goblin artificers. However, the machines unexpectedly activated, revolted against their handlers, and took over the lower and upper tiers of the foundry floor.

faq.q: Where are the goblins who ran this workshop?
faq.answer: Most of the foundry goblins were driven out, scattered into deeper chambers of the mine, or slain when their experimental mechanical creations went haywire and seized control of the workshop.

faq.q: What is the large structure in the center of the room?
faq.answer: The center of the room is dominated by a massive industrial smelting cauldron used to melt down ore hauled from the mines to forge armor plates and mechanical chassis.

angles.text: The foundry stands as a testament to both the brilliance and hazards of goblin tinkering, showcasing how dangerous automated chassis can be when programmed without strict safety failsafes.
Discovering that the rogue harvest golems terrorizing Westfall's farms were being actively upgraded into military weapons here reveals the true extent of the Defias threat.
